Indeed, let's have a look.
I want you to be ready to trade with me on a moment's notice when you see my banner approaching.
Not at this time. Take care.
Very well, let's trade.

Ah, methinks for a humble price of {ARRANGEMENT_COST}{GOLD_ICON}, to pay the boys for running and gathering goods for thee, we shall be keen for such an arrangement. Furthermore, I shall telle thee of about our hamlet and the esteemed folk therein. Does {?PLAYER.GENDER}m'lady{?}m'lord{\\?} concur?
Yes, that sounds acceptable. [Pay {ARRANGEMENT_COST}{GOLD_ICON}]
Splendid! We shall be at your service whenever you need us.
No, perhaps another time.
Yes, I am not done yet.
No. Thank you for your time.
The trader moves around, maybe you could arrange regular trading with this village.
You now know your way around {SETTLEMENT_NAME}.
You don't know the settlement by heart.
You don't have enough gold.
Ah, I see thou hast already been shown the wonders of {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. There is naught more to see.
Indeed, I have seen all there is.

Ho there, sojourner. Thine puzzled face betrays thine nature. Fear thee not, as for the most modest sum, I shall show thee around {SETTLEMENT_NAME}, we shall leave no boulder unturned until thou knows't this corner of earth as thine own. Be thee interested?
Yes, I could use your help. [Pay {COST}{GOLD_ICON}]
Splendid. Let me show thee the ins and outs of our {SETTLEMENT_NAME}.
By heaven's Grace, what are you on about. Not interested.
Local guide
Hail {?PLAYER.GENDER}m'lady{?}m'lord{\\?}, I bid thee welcome to our humble hamlet. I am the village trader here. How may I serve thee?
You need to arrange with the local notables to organize recruitment first.
Can you help organize willing recruits for my company?

Organizing recruits requires cooperation between all the notables here. We'd need to coordinate with everyone - some are... more expensive to convince than others. For {RECRUITMENT_COST}{GOLD_ICON}, I can arrange it so willing volunteers will be ready whenever you visit. Interested?
Yes, arrange it. [Pay {RECRUITMENT_COST}{GOLD_ICON}]
Excellent! I'll speak with the other notables. From now on, you'll find willing volunteers ready when you need them.
Perhaps another time.
What recruits do you have available?
I can offer you: {TROOP_LIST} for {TOTAL_COST}{GOLD_ICON} total.
I'll take them all. [Pay {TOTAL_COST}{GOLD_ICON}]
Excellent! The lads are yours now. Fight well!
Perhaps another time.
Very well. Perhaps when you're ready.
There are no available products right now.
Buy products
I'm looking for someone...
Village shop is not available right now.
Thank you, I appreciate it.
Never mind, I'll find it myself.
The arena.
Can you show me the way somewhere?
The barber.
The lord's hall.
The marketplace.
Never mind.
The smithy.
The tavern.
Follow me to the {LOCATION}!
You've found {FEATURE} of {SETTLEMENT}.
Agreed. Here is the coin.
I'll find my own way.
Let's keep going.
You haven't discovered this part of the settlement yet.
Sorry, I can't guide you there. Ask someone else.
tavern district
Can't you see I'm busy? Find someone else.
I have things to do. Bother someone else.
Not now. I have somewhere to be.
I've already shown you around. Ask someone else.
I helped you once already. I have my own business to attend to.
Find another guide, friend. I've done my part.
Of course! Where would you like to go?
Happy to help! What are you looking for?
Sure thing! Where do you need to get to?
I know this town well... every back alley and shortcut. For {BRIBE_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}, I'll take you wherever you need to go.
Directions? Nothing's free here. {BRIBE_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} and I'll show you personally.
You look lost, friend. For {BRIBE_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}, I could help... for a small fee.
Excellent. Where to?
A pleasure doing business. Now, where are we headed?
Coin well spent. Where do you need to go?
Follow me!
This way — stay close.
Right, let's go. Keep up.
It's empty there right now. Come back during the day.
Nothing to see there at night. Try again in daylight.
They'll be closed at this hour. Come back tomorrow.
Here we are! This is the {DESTINATION}.
We've arrived. The {DESTINATION}, as promised.
There you go — the {DESTINATION}. You can't miss it.
The tavern is just around the corner...
Nearly at the tavern now...
This way — the tavern won't be far.
The marketplace is just ahead...
We're almost at the marketplace...
Keep your eyes open — the market is nearby.
The arena is close by, I can hear the crowds...
Nearly at the arena...
Hear that roar? That's the arena — we're close.
The smithy is nearby, can you smell the forge?
Almost at the smithy...
The hammering should guide us — the smithy is close.
The lord's hall is just ahead...
We're nearly at the lord's hall...
Stay sharp. The keep is close.
It's just over there...
Not much further...
We're close now...
Ugh, imperials... haven't you polluted enough of the world? Get lost.
Another imperial thinking they own the place. We bow to no emperor here.
Take your imperial arrogance elsewhere. You're not wanted.
Crawl back to whatever sandhole you came out of, dog.
We don't serve desert rats here. Go peddle your wares elsewhere.
The stink of the Nahasa follows you, stranger. Move along.
We have no love for horse fondlers here, stranger. Go back to your decrepit steppe.
A Khuzait? In our town? Go back to your yurt, nomad.
I can smell the horse dung from here. Off with you.
How about I call the guards and have you thrown out? Go back to the sea, you are not welcome here.
Another sea raider crawled ashore, did they? Get lost.
Take your longboat and shove off, Nord. We've nothing for you.
Sure... wait, what is that accent... We do not tolerate filthy barbarians here. Leave, while you can.
A forest dweller? In civilized lands? Go hug a tree somewhere else.
I don't deal with painted savages. Away with you.
Hahaha, what? Your wits really have frozen, stranger. Crawl back to {STURGIA_RULER}'s lap.
You Sturgians are all the same — half-drunk and lost. Find your own way.
Go back to your frozen wasteland, snowman. We don't help your kind.
Ahh, a passionate Vlandian... I'll be sure to give my regards to the next goat I see. Now leave before I call the guards.
A Vlandian, eh? Don't you have some peasants to tax or a field to plow? Off with you.
I've had enough of Vlandian 'knights' stumbling through our streets. Find your own way.
I don't help outsiders around here. Move along.
You're not from around here. Figure it out yourself.
We don't take kindly to strangers. Best be on your way.
You need to be introduced to this person first.
{HERO} is in the {LOCATION}. You don't know the way there yet.
{FIRST} and {SECOND}
I could use a favor.
You can't afford it.
You asked for this recently. Come back in {DAYS} days.
You asked for this recently. Come back tomorrow.
Hm. Ask me another time.
The watch is looking for me. Make it go away.{LMMI_FAVOR_PRICE_GANG_CRIME}
You're not wanted for anything here.
Consider it done. A few coins in the right hands and the watch forgets a face.
Anything out there I should know about?{LMMI_FAVOR_PRICE_GANG_HIDEOUTS}
Nothing out there worth your while. The roads have been quiet.
There's a nest of bandits holed up near {PLACES}. You didn't hear it from me.
After what you've done? You've got some nerve.
I remember you. The answer is no.
Favors are for friends. You are not one.
{ITEM} goes for {BUY}{GOLD_ICON} here and fetches {SELL}{GOLD_ICON} in {TOWN}.
What's worth buying here, and where does it sell?{LMMI_FAVOR_PRICE_MERCHANT_TIPS}
Nothing worth the trip right now. Ask me again in a few days.
Here's what I'd do. {TIPS}
Never mind.
As you wish.
Favors? I don't know you, and I don't do favors for nobodies.
Come back when your name means something around here.
You've given me no reason to help you. Yet.
{NAME} doesn't trust you enough for that.
For you? Let's hear it.
You've earned a few favors. What do you need?
Favors cost coin, stranger. What is it?
[{PRICE}{GOLD_ICON}]
You honor me, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}! Whatever you need, it's yours.
{NAME} flatters you, but won't stick their neck out for you.
Find your own way.
Ask someone who cares.
{PLAYER.NAME}, my friend! Good to see you.
Ah, there you are. Come, sit.
You. I remember what you did.
You've got some nerve showing your face here.
Who let you in here?
Whatever you're selling, I'm not buying.
I don't have time for vagrants.
{?PLAYER.GENDER}My lady{?}My lord{\?}! You honor me again.
Ah, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}! Always a pleasure. Always.
The famous {PLAYER.NAME}, in my humble town! What an honor, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}.
{?PLAYER.GENDER}My lady{?}My lord{\?}! Word of your deeds reached us long before you did.
What brings you back?
I don't know you. State your business.
Hm. I don't believe we've dealt before.
You're not from around here, are you? What do you want?
Another stranger. State your business.
Well? Make it quick.
Get on with it.
How may I serve you?
You have some nerve asking me for anything.
I've told you what I think of you. No.
Favors? From me? Ha.
You again? What now?
Back already? Good.
Back so soon, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}? Always a pleasure!
Back already?
Would you put in a word for me with someone here?
{NAME} vouched for you recently. Come back in {DAYS} days.
I'll have a word with {TARGET}. After that, they'll at least hear you out.
Someone else.
{VOUCH_TARGET.NAME} ({VOUCH_ROLE})
{TARGET}? My word would do you more harm than good. We don't get along.
With whom?
{PLAYER.NAME}! How we've missed you. Come — we've prepared a small feast in your honor.
I'd be honored.
Another time, my friend.
Of course. Our door is always open to you.
Eat, drink! Your people are welcome at our table too.
You and your men feast in {SETTLEMENT}: morale +10, {GRAIN} grain, {HEALED} wounded tended.
A word, before you go about your business. Don't trust {SCHEMER}. That one smiles to your face and counts your coin behind your back.
Thank you. I'll remember that.
You. Finish your business and leave. People like you have a way of losing things around here.
Advice. Take it or don't.
I'll go where I please.
Suit yourself.
Is that a threat?
The watch seems to know exactly where to find you. {NAME} took your coin — and talked.
You know a swindle when you see one. (Roguery {SKILL})
{FRIEND} warned you about {NAME}. This smells like a swindle.
Me? I've never set foot here before either. Ask a local.
I know this town about as well as you do. Which is to say, not at all.
Don't look at me. I'm as lost as you are.
Another imperial come to tell us how things were done in the old days? Spare me.
The Empire is dead, and you're what's left of it. Keep walking.
Keep your purple airs to yourself, imperial.
The desert sent us another one. Keep walking.
Go sell your spices to someone who cares, Aserai.
Your kind haggles over everything. Not here, and not with me.
Another steppe rider. Where's your horse? Or did you eat it?
Khuzaits burn our villages, and then they come asking for favors. Leave.
You smell of mare's milk and smoke. Off with you.
A Nord. Did the sea spit you out, or did you swim?
We know what Nords do to coastal towns. Keep your axe where I can see it.
Go back to your cold fjords and your colder gods.
Battanian. Go back to your woods and your standing stones.
Painted face, empty head. Move along.
Your people stole cattle from my grandfather. I haven't forgotten.
Sturgian. Drunk already, or just born that way?
Go back to your snow and your mead-halls.
Your princes couldn't hold their own borders. Why should I help you?
A Vlandian. Everyone, hands on your purses.
Go pay homage to your lord somewhere else, Vlandian.
Your knights trample our fields and then expect courtesy. No.
I don't know where you're from, and I don't care to. Move along.
Your kind always brings trouble. Not today.
Strangers. Always wanting something. Go away.
My cousin says you helped {HELPED}. Around here, that means something.
They say the roads are safer since you came through. Bless you for it.
You're {PLAYER.NAME}, aren't you? {LMMI_ADMIRE}
Wait till I tell my wife I spoke to you!
Glad to help.
Spare a coin, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}? Just a coin. The winter took everything we had.
Here. [20{GOLD_ICON}]
I... thank you. I'll tell everyone what you did. Everyone.
Take this, and eat well tonight. [100{GOLD_ICON}]
Out of my way.
...Yes, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}.
Bless you. Bless you.
[Walk past without a word.]

{?PLAYER.GENDER}My lady{?}My lord{\?}, a small matter, if I may. {LMMI_RIVAL.NAME} has been... difficult. Squeezing my trade, spreading lies about me. A word from someone of your standing would put {?LMMI_RIVAL.GENDER}her{?}him{\?} in {?LMMI_RIVAL.GENDER}her{?}his{\?} place.
I see. I had hoped my gift meant... well. Never mind. Good day.
You are too kind! I won't forget this. Nobody here will.
Your quarrels are your own.
I'll have a word with {LMMI_RIVAL.NAME}.
{PLAYER.NAME}! You kept your word — the whole street knows it. It isn't much, but take this for your trouble. {LMMI_GIFT}{GOLD_ICON}.
Keep it. I was glad to help.
Then I owe you one. I won't forget it.
Thank you.
No, thank you. Come by any time.
{?PLAYER.GENDER}My lady{?}My lord{\?}! Please — a small token of our esteem. {LMMI_GIFT}{GOLD_ICON}. I insist, I insist.
I can't accept this.
Of course, of course. Forgive me. I meant no offense.
You're too generous.
Not at all, not at all! Perhaps one day you might... but no. Another time.
You don't have that much on you.
Who's rotting in the keep these days?{LMMI_FAVOR_PRICE_GANG_PRISONERS}
Nobody worth knowing. Drunks and debtors, the lot of them.
Down in the dungeon? {NAMES}. The guards drink more than they should, and some of them owe me. If you ever wanted someone out... you didn't hear it from me.
{NAME} of the {CLAN}
I have wounded men. Is there anyone here who could tend to them?{LMMI_FAVOR_PRICE_TEND_WOUNDED}
Bring them to the guildhall. Our bonesetter has seen worse — mostly from our own apprentices.
{HEALED} of your wounded were tended in {SETTLEMENT}.
Your people look hale enough to me.
Bring them in. Our wise-woman will see to them. She's stubborn, but she knows her herbs.
My people are hungry. Can your village spare provisions?{LMMI_FAVOR_PRICE_VILLAGE_PROVISIONS}
{NAME} spared you {AMOUNT} grain.
We can spare {AMOUNT} sacks of grain. It isn't much, but it will carry your people a few days.
{PLAYER.NAME}. Good. Sit.
{PLAYER.NAME}! It does my heart good to see you.
Look what the wind blew in. Sit, sit, before someone important sees you.
{PLAYER.NAME}... I'm glad you came.
{?PLAYER.GENDER}My lady{?}My lord{\?}. At your service.
{?PLAYER.GENDER}My lady{?}My lord{\?}, you've come back! I was just telling everyone about you.
The day brightens! Our {?PLAYER.GENDER}great lady{?}great lord{\?} returns.
Welcome back, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}. Whatever you need...
{?PLAYER.GENDER}My lady{?}My lord{\?}. An honor. A true honor.
I have heard so much about you, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}! Welcome, welcome!
Why, the great {PLAYER.NAME} {?PLAYER.GENDER}herself{?}himself{\?}! We are truly blessed.
It is... a great honor, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}. Truly.
Back again? What is it this time?
Back for more, are we?
Oh. It's you. What do you need?
Who are you? Speak.
Yes? What?
I don't think we've met. What brings you to me?
A new face. How exciting. What do you want?
Well, well. Somebody's lost.
Forgive me, I don't believe I know you. What is it you need?
Foreigner. What do you want?
You're a long way from home, stranger. What is it?
Lost your way, stranger? Or just lost?
You're not from here, I think. How can I... help?
Word is you helped {LMMI_HELPED}. That counts for something around here.
You're the one who sorted out {LMMI_HELPED}'s troubles, aren't you? Everyone's talking.
You helped {LMMI_HELPED}. I heard. Speak.
{LMMI_HELPED} speaks well of you. That's rare. What can I do for you?
Ah, {LMMI_HELPED}'s savior. The whole street won't shut up about you.
I heard what you did for {LMMI_HELPED}. It was... kind.
{LMMI_INTRO_NAME}. Not that it's any business of yours.
The name's {LMMI_INTRO_NAME}. Remember it, so you'll know whom to avoid.
{LMMI_INTRO_NAME}. My workshop, my rules. You'll find no welcome in it.
{LMMI_INTRO_NAME}. People who cross me tend to end up in the river. Remember that.
I'm {LMMI_INTRO_NAME}. And my goods are not for the likes of you.
{LMMI_INTRO_NAME}. This village doesn't want trouble, and you look like trouble.
Do you know anyone in the towns around here who might open a door for me?
You carry {WRITER}'s letter of introduction to {TARGET} in {TOWN}.
{NAME} wrote a letter for you recently. Ask again later.
I carry a letter for you, from {LMMI_LETTER_FROM}.
{LMMI_LETTER_FROM}'s seal... Well. Any friend of {LMMI_LETTER_FROM} is worth hearing out. What can I do for you?
Safe travels. And don't read it — the seal will tell.
{NAME} doesn't put {?NAME_HERO.GENDER}her{?}his{\?} seal on letters for strangers.

{LMMI_LETTER_TARGET.NAME} in {LMMI_LETTER_TOWN} owes me a favor or two. Give {?LMMI_LETTER_TARGET.GENDER}her{?}him{\?} this letter — whatever {?LMMI_LETTER_TARGET.GENDER}she thinks{?}he thinks{\?} of your kind, {?LMMI_LETTER_TARGET.GENDER}she'll{?}he'll{\?} hear you out.
an old friend
The letter of introduction to {TARGET} has gone stale. Too late to deliver it now.
Perhaps another time.
I'll deliver it myself.
I'm short of coin. Would you lend me some?
On second thought, no.
As you like.
Then it's done. Don't make me regret it.
For you? I can spare {LMMI_LOAN_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}. Pay me back {LMMI_LOAN_OWED}{GOLD_ICON} within {LMMI_LOAN_DAYS} days. I trust you — but my ledger doesn't.
{LMMI_LOAN_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON}, today. You'll owe me {LMMI_LOAN_OWED}{GOLD_ICON} in {LMMI_LOAN_DAYS} days. And friend — I always collect.
Your debt to {NAME} of {TOWN} is overdue. {NAME} is telling anyone who'll listen.
Your debt to {NAME} of {TOWN} is overdue. They say {NAME} always collects. You should watch the roads.
I'm stretched thin myself, I'm afraid. Ask me another time.
Right on time. A pleasure doing business with you.
Late, but paid. I'll remember both.
Smart. Very smart.
There. Was that so hard? My men will be glad to hear they can stand down.
I've come to settle my debt. [{LMMI_LOAN_REPAY}{GOLD_ICON}]
You don't have enough coin.
Favors cost coin, stranger. More for your kind.
For a foreigner? It'll cost you. Go on.
Out with it.
I'm listening. Barely.
Anything you need, you have only to ask.
A hand slid toward your purse in the tavern district. You caught the wrist before it got there.
Your purse feels lighter. Somewhere in {TOWN}'s tavern district, someone had quick fingers: {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON} gone.
What now.
Did I not make myself clear the first time?
Oh, good. You're back.
Back so soon? Come in, come in.
Missed me already?
{NAME}'s Men
Someone you crossed
Rough men slip out of {TOWN} behind you, keeping their distance. {NAME}'s people, by the look of them.
{NAME} wants the coin you owe. All of it, with interest — and if you can't pay, we take it out of your hide.
{NAME} told you to finish your business and leave. You should have listened.
{NAME} sends regards. Hand over your purse, and maybe we let you walk.
{PLAYER.NAME}! A pleasure, a true pleasure. You simply must come hunting with my family, when the wars allow.
Splendid! I shall hold you to it.
[Nod politely and say nothing.]
Perhaps I will.
{PLAYER.NAME}. Good. There are few faces in this hall I'm glad to see.
Find me later. We'll talk properly, away from all these ears.
The feeling is mutual.
Mind your tongue, my lord.
[Incline your head slightly and move on.]
Or what? Do go on. The whole hall is listening.
One hears the lords of {REALM} will receive anyone these days. Even your kind.
Keep your distance, foreigner. This hall is for the nobility of {REALM}.
And who might you be? No, don't tell me. I'm sure it's of no consequence.
Another petitioner. The steward is over there. Do try not to track mud across the floor.
{VOUCHER} vouched for you with {OWNER}. Word of how that turned out has reached {VOUCHER}.
Fine. The volunteers will be there. Don't expect anyone to smile about it.
Done. Don't make me regret it.
Organize recruits — for you? ...Coin is coin. But the others will want paying, and more for the likes of you. {RECRUITMENT_COST}{GOLD_ICON}. Take it or leave it.
It can be arranged. It won't be cheap — the others don't know you any better than I do. {RECRUITMENT_COST}{GOLD_ICON}.
Good riddance.
Don't come back.
And stay gone.
Leaving so soon? What a pity.
Always a pleasure, {?PLAYER.GENDER}my lady{?}my lord{\?}! Do come again!
You honor us. Truly.
Go on, then.
Be on your way.
Safe travels, I suppose.
{?PLAYER.GENDER}Kinswoman{?}Kinsman{\?}. What is it?
A {DEMONYM} at the keep. What do you want? Make it quick.
My people are all busy. Ask around — somebody out there will point you the right way.
A local will take you to the {LOCATION}. Follow them.
Your guide can't seem to find a way through. Better ask someone else.
Word is you've done right by this town. Even for a {DEMONYM}. Go on, then.
My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}. Welcome to {SETTLEMENT}. We'll... keep an eye out for you.
Welcome to {SETTLEMENT}. Behave, and we'll get along.
Welcome, {?PLAYER.GENDER}kinswoman{?}kinsman{\?}. Keep your nose clean and you'll have no trouble here.
One of ours. Good. Mind the cutpurses near the market.
Welcome to {SETTLEMENT}, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}. Good to see one of our own doing well.
Hands where I can see them, Aserai. Your kind have quick fingers.
Leave the woad and the war cries at the gate, Battanian.
An imperial. Remember whose town this is now.
Ahh... a {DEMONYM}. Ugh. You're lucky our lord lets foreign scum walk around untouched.
Keep your horse out of the fountain, {SLUR}.
Keep that axe sheathed, Nord. This isn't a beach you're raiding.
No brawling, northerner. If there's a broken head tonight, I'll know whose it was.
Another Vlandian. Try not to swear fealty to anything while you're here.
the lord
Right, of course you do, Aserai. No goats to fondle in there, though. The animal pens are that way. Now scram. (Not enough renown)
No trees to hug in there, Battanian. Off you go. (Not enough renown)
Imperial airs won't open this door, friend. Not anymore. (Not enough renown)
We don't know you, stranger, and I don't much like the look of you. No. (Not enough renown)
The lord's hall isn't a stable, nomad. Try the one out back. (Not enough renown)
Sorry, {?PLAYER.GENDER}kinswoman{?}kinsman{\?}, but we don't know you. Make a name for yourself first. (Not enough renown)
No longboats to beach in there, Nord. Move along. (Not enough renown)
Hah! And I want to share {RULER}'s bed, for all the good wanting does me. Move along, {DEMONYM}. (Not enough renown)
The hall's not a mead-house, northerner. Sober up and try again. Or don't. (Not enough renown)
A Vlandian wants to see the lord. To swear another oath you'll break? No. (Not enough renown)
I heard you may need some help with a problem?
Help? From a {DEMONYM}? I don't trust your kind with my affairs. Why should I trust you?
Help? From some nobody off the road? I don't hand my troubles to strangers. Why should I trust you?
{NAME} has made it clear what they think of you. Give it a few days.
Your problem won't solve itself, and I don't see anyone else lining up. Do you have a lot of choice?
I'd do it for less than anyone would ask. Call it an introduction.
You have my word. I don't abandon a job, whatever you think of my people.
Words. Everyone has words. Get out of my sight.
Forget it.
Whatever it is, I've faced worse. Let me prove it.
...Fine. Maybe you're not like the rest of them. Here's what I need.
{?PLAYER.GENDER}Kinswoman{?}Kinsman{\?}. What brings you down to the cells?
What does a {DEMONYM} want at the dungeon? Visiting relatives?
They're yours. Pay them on time and they'll follow you well enough.
{TROOP_LIST}. {TOTAL_COST}{GOLD_ICON}, and not a coin less. I don't haggle with your kind.
I've got {TROOP_LIST}. {TOTAL_COST}{GOLD_ICON}. Take it or leave it.
Take them and go. Fools, following a foreigner — but that's their business, not mine.
Take them. Try not to get them all killed.
desert dog
wood hugger
purple-robed windbag
horse fondler
frozen drunk
Huh. Didn't expect this from a {LMMI_SLUR}. Word is you stood up for one of ours.
So you're the {LMMI_SLUR} everyone's talking about. Stepped in when our own wouldn't, they say.
You. The {LMMI_SLUR} who helped. Hm. Speak, then.
A {LMMI_SLUR} playing the hero. Now I've seen everything. ...It was well done, I'll grant you.
Word is you stood up for one of ours. Good. That's how it should be.
You there — show this one to the {LOCATION}. Don't dawdle, and don't get lost.
